# Ned offline adaptation

Original authors: garrytan/gstack authors and contributors

Upstream: https://github.com/garrytan/gstack/blob/1d3c63c53d17faf0456c564bc5950f18b370d0ef/qa-only/SKILL.md

Commit: 1d3c63c53d17faf0456c564bc5950f18b370d0ef

License: MIT; see LICENSE. Preserve attribution and source links. Modifications by Ned contributors, 2026-11-13. The upstream authors do not endorse Ned.

This is a selective static host adapter, not an installation of the upstream executable plugin, CLI, agents or validators. The method was condensed for Korean/offline use. Online installation, telemetry, cloud services, automatic update, mandatory Q&A, external issue trackers and parallel-agent procedures were omitted. Tools map to Ned host reads/search, approved project edits and available reviewed runtimes. Missing executors and image generation remain explicitly unavailable.
